headline: El Nino linked downpours trigger severe flooding in Peru and Ecuador leaving 34 de@d
label: NEWS
caption:
Severe weather caused by the El Nino phenomenon has triggered massive flooding across Peru and Ecuador. 🌊

According to Al Jazeera and TRT World, heavy rains have left 34 people de@d and affected 47,000 people in Ecuador.

In northern Peru, waist high water filled the streets of Piura after 12 hours of heavy rains, affecting some 2,000 families according to preliminary reports.

Floodwaters forced authorities to relocate patients from a hospital respiratory ward to its auditorium, while Peru armed forces deployed personnel to remove accumulated water.

In neighbouring Ecuador, residents waded through chest deep water and floated on mattresses in Manta after two rivers broke their banks.
